versions.subject: rule: additional rule using the obfuscated IPs
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
        - 'iwr '
        - 'wget '
        - 'curl '
        - 'DownloadFile'
        - 'DownloadString'
selection_ip:
    - CommandLine|contains: 
        - '//0x'
        - '.0x'
        - '.00x'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'http://%'
        - '%2e'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: CommandLine IN ("*Invoke-WebRequest*", "*iwr *", "*wget *", "*curl *", "*DownloadFile*", "*DownloadString*") CommandLine IN ("*//0x*", "*.0x*", "*.00x*") OR (CommandLine="*http://%*" CommandLine="*%2e*")
